210030202.text: You have my thanks. I'll stay here and keep watch to stop anyone from taking a wrong turn and ending up deep in Dihua Marsh...

210031101.text: Thanks for helping clear out the monsters. I am sorry to have to ask you — I know it should be my job, I just really need your help...

210031102.text: *sigh* If only we had more men, there'd be no issue.

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat all opponents in the camp

210032001.text: Thanks for helping clear out the monsters. I am sorry to have to ask you — I know it should be my job, I just really need your help...

210032002.text: *sigh* If only we had more men, there'd be no issue.

210033003.text: Hmm? Who goes there? All who wish to cross this bridge are subject to interrogation, those are the rules.

210033004.text: That said... Just look at what you're wearing! You're definitely not someone I need to worry about...

210033005.text: Why? Think about it — criminals would want to dress as discreetly as possible, no? You, on the other hand, are dressed most ostentatiously indeed.

210033006.text: I am the Millelith responsible for this zone. This is a major thoroughfare to Dihua Marsh. Merchants and tourists all pass this way, so I'm stationed here to stand guard.

210033007.text: Just the other day, I discovered a group of monsters nearby... It appears they've set up a camp, and although they haven't made a move yet it's definitely a safety risk. I need to keep an eye on them.

210033008.text: I'd happily go and clear them out... except, I worry that if I left my post here, some other monsters would seize the chance to ambush passers-by. I feel so helpless, stuck here all day...

210033010.text: Seriously? All of them? That's... fantastic!

210033011.text: This was a huge help. I am sorry I had to ask you — it should have been my job, but you ended up doing it all for me...

210033012.text: Ugh, I don't know what the higher-ups are thinking, they really should have sent some more people by now. This zone is far too big for only one person...

210033013.text: They will be getting a full report on this situation as soon as I have the opportunity.

210033014.text: You have my thanks. Please take these for your trouble.

210039902.text: I have dealt with the monsters.

210039903.text: Thank you, it's a huge help. I am sorry I had to ask you — it should have been my job, but you ended up doing it all for me...

210039904.text: ...There's no point you trying to play it down, you're covered in dust, which I'm sure is from a tooth-and-nail battle with the monsters.

210039905.text: Ugh, I don't know what the higher-ups are thinking, they really should have sent some more people by now. This zone is far too big for only one person...

210039906.text: It may be just a couple of bridges, but so much human traffic comes through here every day. If anything were to happen here, it would be catastrophic...

210039907.text: The higher-ups will be getting a full report on this situation as soon as I have the opportunity.

210039908.text: You have my thanks. Please take these for your trouble.

210030111.text: *sigh* If only we had more men, there'd be no issue.

210030112.text: I'd happily go and clear them out — except, I worry that if I left my post here, some other monsters would seize the chance to ambush passers-by. I feel so helpless, stuck here all day...

210030113.text: Can you go and sort out the monsters over there for me? It would free me up to concentrate on other matters...
